title: Lomachenko Footwork, at Home
sub: Monday to Friday. Inspired by how Lomachenko trains, not his exact program.
note: As a kid, Lomachenko spent about 4 years in traditional Ukrainian dance before going back to boxing. His footwork is drilled, not gifted.

items: Fast small steps on the balls of your feet.
Throw at a wall, catch with the other hand.
Slip or punch on a called cue
A partner or a random-call app says slip or punch.
Partner drops a ball, catch before the second bounce.
